{{Quote|May the Force be with you, Adi.|Obi-Wan Kenobi, in a message to Adi Gallia on Agomar|<ref name="Wild Space" />}}
The '''Battle of Agomar''' took place in the [[22 BBY/Legends|first year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] clashed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agomar]]. While [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] and her [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] forces engaged a Separatist detachment on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world, the Republic was able to secure a victory thanks to a [[nanovirus]] that caused the Separatists' [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] to turn on one another in the midst of the battle.

==Prelude==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="ERC" /> the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] took on a proactive role in the war as its members personally commanded several of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] campaigns against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. One such engagement took place when [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] encountered a Separatist detachment on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agomar]].<ref name="Wild Space" />

==The battle==
[[File:AdiGallia-SWE.png|thumb|left|150px|Adi Gallia battled the Separatists on Agomar.]]
Gallia clashed with a Separatist contingent on Agomar,<ref name="Wild Space" /> leading her groups of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] against the enemy.<ref name="Essential Guide to Warfare" /> During the fighting, she was contacted by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who was passing close by to Agomar while on a [[Mission to Zigoola|mission]] to the planet [[Zigoola]] with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]]. Kenobi had been trying to transmit a message to [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] but had been unable to do so due to the distance from the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]], so Gallia promised to relay his message back to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] at the next opportunity.<ref name="Wild Space" />

The Republic eventually unleashed a [[nanovirus]] on the Separatists' [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] on Agomar, causing [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] and [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] to turn on each other, with numerous [[Legion/Legends|legions]] of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] caught in the middle of the chaos,<ref name="OEG:S1" /> to the mirth of the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]].<ref name="Essential Guide to Warfare" /> Thanks to the Republic's sabotage,<ref name="OEG:S1" /> Gallia<ref name="Wild Space" /> and the Republic emerged victorious on the planet.<ref name="OEG:S1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Agomar<ref name="OEG:S1" /> was created in supplementary material for the [[2008]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series and was first alluded to in the [[December]] 2008 novel ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''. Although the book only solidified Adi Gallia's participation in the conflict,<ref name="Wild Space" /> the battle was later expanded upon in the [[October]] [[2009]] publication [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1|''The Official Episode Guide: Season 1'']], which also provided the campaign with an official name.<ref name="OEG:S1" />
